headline_item.title_zh: 毕马威首个AI代理审计项目完成
headline_item.title_en: AI asked ‘better questions’ than KPMG accountants in pilot audit
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 毕马威通过“指数化项目”部署百余个AI代理，对一家富时250指数成分股公司进行平行审计验证
headline_item.event_summary_en: KPMG UK conducted its first end-to-end AI audit on a FTSE 250 firm, deploying over 100 AI agents under 'Project Exponential' to execute data collection and analysis. While AI demonstrated superior query depth compared to human auditors, the experiment revealed persistent limitations in regulatory mapping requiring human intervention.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】毕马威（KPMG）英国审计负责人Cath Burnet及审计团队：通过“指数化项目”利用100多个AI代理进行财务报表平行审计，并在部分环节实现自主决策
【起因与机理】旨在验证AI在提升审计效率、挖掘财务异常方面的潜力，寻求降低劳动力密集型审计成本的路径
【核心事实细节】毕马威开展名为“指数化项目”的AI平行审计，部署百余名AI代理进行测试。
【各方立场与态度】行业正处于AI替代人工审计的初期验证期，尚未解决费用削减与合规边界的核心博弈。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Cath Burnet, Head of Audit at KPMG UK (UK audit practice): Deployed 100+ AI agents for a parallel audit of a FTSE 250 company, enabling autonomous data analysis and suggestion of next steps.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To test potential for efficiency gains and cost reduction in labor-intensive auditing processes.
[Key Technical Spec] KPMG launched 'Project Exponential', utilizing 100+ AI agents for parallel audit testing.
[Key Position & Outlook] The industry is currently in an early validation phase, struggling to balance cost reduction with rigorous compliance.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此次实验标志着审计行业从辅助工具向“代理化作业”转型的临界点，AI Agent在审计风控中已具备初步的逻辑推理能力。然而，审计本质是法律责任承担，AI在语义逻辑与复杂合规边界的模糊地带依然存在高频的幻觉风险，导致行业短期内无法完全脱离“人机协同”的审计范式。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This trial marks a pivot from AI-assisted tools to agent-driven workflows in professional services. While AI agents demonstrate high-level reasoning, the inherent legal liability of audits and AI's persistent risk of hallucinations in complex regulatory mapping ensure that a 'human-in-the-loop' paradigm remains mandatory for the foreseeable future.

headlines.title_zh: 腾讯营收不及预期，AI转型压力凸显
headlines.title_en: Tencent’s Sales Miss Estimates in Setback for Founder’s AI Push
headlines.event_summary_zh: 腾讯第三季度营收增长不及预期，马化腾强调AI投入关乎生存，面临地缘监管与内部转型的多重挑战
headlines.event_summary_en: Tencent reported Q3 revenue of 207.3 billion yuan, growing by 8%, which missed analyst projections. Amid mounting competition from Alibaba and ByteDance, co-founder Pony Ma is driving an aggressive internal AI shift, launching the Hy4 model; however, the company faces external headwinds from US restrictions on Chinese access to Southeast Asian data centers for AI training.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】腾讯公司创始人马化腾、腾讯云与智慧产业事业群CEO汤道生在中国互联网市场及地缘监管环境：营收增长未达预期，正推动全员AI战略并加速WorkBuddy等工具落地，同时应对数据中心访问权限受限的外部风险
【起因与机理】AI时代的竞争格局加速演变，腾讯试图通过大模型与AI代理转型以寻求新的增长曲线
【关键数据与实测】第三季度营收2073亿元，增长8%，低于市场分析师平均预期。
【行业影响与走向】外部面临美方限制东南亚数据中心访问权的监管封锁，地缘政治风险叠加竞争加剧。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Pony Ma (Co-founder, Tencent), Dowson Tong (CEO of CSIG): Revenue missed projections; pursuing aggressive AI integration (Hy4, WorkBuddy) while navigating restrictions on Southeast Asian data centers.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address stagnation in traditional businesses and pivot toward the AI era to compete with Alibaba and ByteDance.
[Key Metrics] Q3 revenue reached 207.3 billion yuan, reflecting 8% growth, which missed consensus expectations.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Geopolitical risks include US restrictions on Southeast Asian data center access, impacting model training efficiency.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 腾讯的财务失速反映了从流量变现逻辑向算力价值驱动转型过程中的阵痛期。美方对数据中心的算力封锁已从单纯的“芯片禁运”演变为“基础设施生态屏蔽”，这直接干扰了中国头部大厂的算力集群构建成本，腾讯未来需依赖WeChat Agent这类应用层护城河以抵消底层算力供应链波动的地缘风险。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Tencent’s financial underperformance reflects the growing pains of shifting from a traffic-monetization model to an AI-compute-driven one. US restrictions on data center access signify a shift from semiconductor export controls to infrastructure ecosystem blocking, necessitating that Tencent double down on application-layer moats like WeChat agents to buffer against underlying supply chain instability.

headlines.title_zh: Osmo研发嗅觉基础模型实现人脑级识别
headlines.title_en: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
headlines.event_summary_zh: AI初创企业Osmo开发出嗅觉基础模型，在气味识别与合成领域达到人类专家水平，已在香氛行业落地应用
headlines.event_summary_en: Osmo, founded by former Google Brain researcher Alex Wiltschko, has developed the first foundation model for smell using a proprietary dataset of 10 million human labels and 800 million 'scent tokens'. The model demonstrates human-level proficiency in identifying and synthesizing scents, outperforming professional perfumers in tests conducted by major global consumer goods companies.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Osmo创始人 Alex Wiltschko在美国新泽西州纽瓦克实验室：通过化学传感器分析与人工嗅觉标注，构建气味基础模型并投入香氛商业化应用
【起因与机理】利用数据驱动的机器学习填补气味科学中长期存在的“数据集匮乏”及行业封闭性缺口
【关键数据与实测】Osmo构建了涵盖1000万人工标注与8亿气味Token的独特数据集。
【各方立场与态度】未来有望扩展至机场安检、疾病辅助诊断等复杂感知场景。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Alex Wiltschko, Founder of Osmo (Lab in Newark, New Jersey): Built a foundation model for olfaction using chemical sensor data and human labeling for commercial fragrance design
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To bridge the data scarcity and industry secrecy in olfactory science through large-scale machine learning
[Key Metrics] The Gates Foundation, which invested $5 million when Osmo launched, later gave the company a $3.
[Key Position & Outlook] Future applications target airport security and medical diagnostics.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 嗅觉数字化是AI在非视觉/听觉感知领域的最后一片蓝海，Osmo通过将气味分子转化为可量化的“Token”，成功绕过了传统香氛行业高度依赖个人经验的闭环壁垒。该技术若在机场安检或病理诊断场景实现低成本部署，将重塑感官传感器产业链，推动生物感知计算进入商业化深水区。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Olfactory digitalization represents the final frontier for AI in sensory perception, where Osmo has bypassed industry opacity by tokenizing molecular data. If successfully deployed in low-cost hardware for threat detection or diagnostics, this will disrupt the sensory sensor supply chain and accelerate the commercialization of biological sensory computing.

titans.quote_zh:
GPT-6.2 Astra 是我们有史以来最强大的网络模型。在 ExploitBench 内部端口上，它比 GPT-6 Astra 跃升了 22 个点。

由于功能增强，我们推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol，为高风险网络安全援助提供更严格的保障措施。我们正在努力将这些模型引入 Daybreak，以便获得批准的防御者可以在减少拒绝的情况下访问它们。
titans.quote_en:
GPT-6.2 Astra is our most capable model ever for cyber. It jumps 22 points over GPT-6 Astra on ExploitBench Internal Port.

Due to increased capabilities, we’re launching GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance. We are working to bring these models to Daybreak so approved defenders can access them with reduced refusals.
